verses.1: And when a person presents an offering of food to God, it will become his offering. He will pour syrup over it, and then he will place it in the sacred vessel.
verses.2: And she brought it to the sons of Aaron, the priests. Then the priest burned incense from it on all its utensils and instruments. The priest also burned the aroma of this incense as an offering to God.
verses.3: And the portion from the offering that was given to Aaron and his sons was holy, most holy, according to the commands of Jehovah.
verses.4: And when you bring offerings of food, such as honey, olive oil, sick people’s offerings, and other gifts, these should be offered in the Temple.
verses.5: And if there is any offering on your lamb’s altar, it must be a clean sacrifice, without any impurities.
verses.6: You will make it into pieces, and you will pour honey over it.
verses.7: And if there is a sacrifice of grain for your brother’s circumcision, then it shall be done.
verses.8: And you shall bring the offering that is to be made for Yahweh, and you shall offer it to the priest. Then you shall give it to the priest.
verses.9: And the priest took the memorial of it from the offering, and he burned incense on it to honor Jehovah.
verses.10: And the offering from the sacrifice, given to Aaron and his sons, was sacred and holy, made by the hands of Jehovah.
verses.11: All the offerings that you bring to Jehovah should not be burned with fire. For everything else and all kinds of offerings should not be burned from them for Jehovah’s use.
verses.12: At the beginning, they shall be brought before Jehovah and before the altar. They shall not be allowed to come near to worship there.
verses.13: And every sacrifice you offer in salt, you must also salt it. Do not remove the salt from your offerings. You must bring the salt as an offering to God.
verses.14: And if you offer an offering in the vineyards to the LORD, then let it be a light offering. Let it be burned on fire. You shall offer your offerings in your vineyards.
verses.15: And you gave her honey, and you placed upon her the grain as a offering.
verses.16: And the priest burned the incense on its altar and on its utensils, as an offering to the LORD.
